content.doc_md:
## Tutorials

The RTRIM() function removes trailing spaces from a string.

Note:Also look at theLTRIM()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT RTRIM('SQL Tutorial     ') AS RightTrimmedString;

---

RTRIM(
string
)
```

## Tutorials

The SOUNDEX() function returns a four-character code to evaluate the 
similarity of two expressions.

Note:The SOUNDEX() converts the string to a four-character 
code based on how the string sounds when spoken.

Tip:Also look at theDIFFERENCE()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SOUNDEX('Juice'), SOUNDEX('Jucy');

---

SOUNDEX(
expression
)

---

SELECT SOUNDEX('Juice'), SOUNDEX('Banana');
```

## Tutorials

The SPACE() function returns a string of the specified number of space characters.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SPACE(10);

---

SPACE(
number
)
```

## Tutorials

The STR() function returns a number as a string.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT STR(185);

---

STR(
number
,
length
,
decimals
)

---

SELECT STR(185.5);

---

SELECT STR(185.476, 6, 2);
```

## Tutorials

The STUFF() function deletes a part of a string and then inserts another 
part into the string, starting at a specified position.

Tip:Also look at theREPLACE()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT STUFF('SQL Tutorial', 1, 3, 'HTML');

---

STUFF(
string
,
start
,
length
,
new_string
)

---

SELECT STUFF('SQL Tutorial!', 13, 1, ' is fun!');
```
